content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — capacity_exhaustion_autoscaler (sev=P0) in us-west-2. Queue depth for inference-queue-frontend > 120k, autoscaler desired=40 current=12 failed_attempts=7. Latency spike > 2s. Link: https://pd.example/incident/INC-12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident INC-12345 fired, assigned -> @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: acked. pulling up runbook now. @carol_sre can you look at cluster autoscaler logs? I'll start manual scale steps.

carol_sre: on it. checking cloud API errors — seeing quota errors during node allocate. logs: `ERROR alloc node: quotaExceeded: requested=28 available=12`. Kube events: ProvisioningTimedOut for several pods.

alice_oncall: understood. manual mitigation: filing cloud request for on-demand nodes and starting a temporary scale on the deployment. running: `kubectl scale deployment inference-front --replicas=100` (may hit pending pods).

bob_eng: noticing a config change ~20m ago that bumped resource requests on model-worker and reduced packing. reverting that change now: `git revert -m 1 4f3a2b` then triggering rollout.

dave_support: customer-facing: multiple customers reporting 503s on batched endpoints. I've opened ticket #SUP-998, tagging for updates. Any ETA?

alice_oncall: manual cloud request submitted (ticket CLD-768). also toggling prefix KVCACHE to reduce load on workers: `feature-flag cache-prefix on` in prod.

carol_sre: cloud accepted request; provisioning started. nodes: 5/8 ready. autoscaler still logs `scaleLoop error: quotaExceeded` while reconcile continues.

alice_oncall: starting a controlled backlog drain once nodes ready. commands: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-front` then `kubectl exec backlog-processor -- drain --parallel=50`.

bob_eng: revert complete. new pods scheduling with better packing heuristics. should help reduce pending pod pressure.

dave_support: updating SUP-998: "We have mitigation in progress; partial relief expected in 10-20 minutes. Engineers are scaling fallback capacity and reverting a config change that increased resource pressure."

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-12345 acknowledged by alice_oncall — escalation suppressed.

carol_sre: all requested on-demand nodes are now ready. scheduler placing pods. queue depth trending down: 126k -> 43k over 8 minutes. 95p latency dropped from ~2.3s -> ~0.6s.

alice_oncall: keeping thread open for verification. action items: add quota-guard to autoscaler + runbook step to trigger on-demand fallback. assign to @bob_eng and @carol_sre.

bob_eng: creating PR for quota guard now. link: https://git.example/repo/pull/2345

dave_support: customers notified with status update. will close support alert once metrics stable for 30 minutes.

alice_oncall: ack. If we see re-spike, escalate to infra-ops for quota increase. leaving monitoring on high-frequency for next 60m.

(keeping thread for post-incident writeup; will follow up with timeline and PR link)
